violations.text: Establishment has a full time manager on site certified as a food safety manager, but establishment does not have someone state licensed as a food safety manager. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen and service area were lacking paper towels. PIC refilled during inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026

Inspector observed ice and coffee residue in the hand-washing sink in kitchen area. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026

The presence of large and small flies are not controlled as evidenced by live large and small flies. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: - donut display and bottom shelves - counters and shelves below - sides of equipment of prep unit and oven area - milk and sugar equipment - wire racks in 1 door cooler - lowboy cooler units Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026
Hot water lacking at hand sink in front counter/prep area. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/02/2026
Inspector observed slow drains at both handwashing sinks (kitchen/service area). New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The floors (especially under equipment in the service and kitchen area) have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/02/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of black and pink residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Unit taken out of service to be washed and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 04/02/2026

The door to the outside, located in the (front entrance ), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 04/02/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the (front counter prep shelves and donut display bottom shelves ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 04/02/2026
Hot water lacking at hand sinks in kitchen and front counter/prep area. New Violation. Correct By: 04/02/2026

The floors in back kitchen and front counter area have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 04/02/2026
Observed scoop with handle in direct contact with sugar.PIC removed scoop. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2024
